name: Numbers that are not the sum of at most five 4-full numbers.
comment: Erdős and Ivić conjectured every sufficiently large integer the sum of at most r+1 many r-full numbers, which would imply this sequence is finite.
Heath-Brown has proved the conjecture for r=2.
reference: D. R. Heath-Brown, "Ternary Quadratic Forms and Sums of Three Square-Full Numbers." In Séminaire de Théorie des Nombres, Paris 1986-87 (Ed. C. Goldstein). Boston, MA: Birkhauser, pp. 137-163, 1988.
mathematica: Complement[Range[n], Flatten[Outer[Plus, t, t, t, t, t]]]
